question.text: NGO DARPAN — the government-backed Information Repository referenced in Chapter 2 — is operated by which body?

answer.text: NITI Aayog in collaboration with the Ministry of Home Affairs and the Ministry of Electronics and IT.
Ministry of Corporate Affairs under the MCA21 platform.
Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI).

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 2.2.4, NGO DARPAN is 'an online platform by NITI Aayog, in collaboration with the Ministry of Home Affairs and the Ministry of Electronics and IT, providing a centralized database of NGOs in India. It has aggregated self-declared information on over 320,000 different NPOs. It enables NGOs to register for a unique ID, essential for government grants.' The Trap: Option A (SEBI + RBI) is off-piste — neither regulator manages NPO directories. Option C (MCA21) captures only Section 8 companies, not Trusts / Societies. Option D (ICAI) runs the SRO, not DARPAN. Cross-Exam Context: XII (Securities Markets Foundation) treats regulator/ministry mapping. In XXIV/IFSCA-01 AML, FCRA reporting touches MHA — relevant overlap.
